newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian soybean, oil, meal down on limited demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian soybean, oil, meal down on limited demand.

text.p: Soybean prices remained bearish on limited demand from processing plants against increased arrivals on Monday, dealers said.

Prices were down by 50-100 rupees per tonne in central Indian markets and arrivals were around 1,000 tonnes. Soybean prices were down 300-400 rupees per tonne in plant delivery condition. Business volume was better and the undertone easy.
Soyoil prices remained bearish on limited demand. Soyoil solvent was down by 100 rupees per tonne and soyoil refined was down by 300 rupees per tonne. The undertone was easy.

Soymeal and rapeseed extraction prices were also down on very limited export demand against increased offerings from Indian processors and exporters. Soymeal yellow was $322-323 per tonne FAS (Free alongside ship) in bulk for export. Rapeseed extraction was $120-122 per tonne FAS in bulk for export and was 4,250 rupese per tonne in FOR (Free on Rail) condition. Business volume was dull and the undertone was easy.
